title: Uniform one-query zero-string tester
statement: For a positive integer $n$, define a randomized nonadaptive tester for Boolean strings of length $n$ by choosing an index uniformly from the $n$ positions, querying that position, and applying the all-zero transcript acceptance predicate to the answer.
